    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">《Dream to Control: Learning Behaviors by Latent Imagination》随记</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<blockquote>
<p>博客地址：<a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/zylyehuo/" target="_blank">https://www.cnblogs.com/zylyehuo/</a></p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>参考链接：<a href="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV17e411k7zS/?spm_id_from=333.337.search-card.all.click&amp;vd_source=4acdb875c05ce9dccfce3cd6cfaac651" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">从DreamerV1到DreamerV3｜Model-based RL的学习之路</a></p>
</blockquote>
<h1 id="dreamerv1-的主要贡献">DreamerV1 的主要贡献</h1>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202603/3071480-20260315214321754-229582269.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h1 id="阶段一学习世界模型dynamics-learning">阶段一：学习世界模型（Dynamics Learning）</h1>
<blockquote>
<p>具体可以参考链接：<a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/zylyehuo/p/19721832" target="_blank">《Learning Latent Dynamics for Planning from Pixels》随记</a></p>
</blockquote>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202603/3071480-20260315183744123-796179344.jpg" alt="RSSM" loading="lazy"><br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202603/3071480-20260315203331269-1531794033.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h1 id="阶段二在潜空间中想象behavior-learning">阶段二：在潜空间中想象（Behavior Learning）</h1>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202603/3071480-20260315203101497-1803005356.jpg" alt="6c99777485e5da64f19017fc81feb0e3" loading="lazy"></p>
<blockquote>
<p>要注意，其中只有 Actor 的参数可以通过反向传播更新参数，别的部分都是固定参数，不能更新。</p>
</blockquote>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202603/3071480-20260315204902214-434453064.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<blockquote>
<p>如图所示，有三条路径（蓝线）对 Actor 进行反向传播。</p>
</blockquote>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202603/3071480-20260315203339361-30430458.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h1 id="阶段三与环境交互environment-interaction">阶段三：与环境交互（Environment Interaction）</h1>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202603/3071480-20260315203353366-2020141445.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h1 id="planet-和-dreamer-的异同">PlaNet 和 Dreamer 的异同</h1>
<blockquote>
<p>PlaNet = 世界模型（RSSM） + 在线实时推演找最优解 。</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>Dreamer = 世界模型（RSSM） + 离线在梦境中训练 Actor/Critic + 依靠 Actor 实时反应 。</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>PlaNet 不是 Dreamer 的前奏，而是它的“前身”。Dreamer 是站在 PlaNet 的肩膀上，把耗时的“在线规划”替换成了更优雅、更具长远目光的“梦境 Actor-Critic 训练” 。</p>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="相同点">相同点</h2>
<blockquote>
<p>不管是 PlaNet 还是 Dreamer，它们认识世界的方式是一模一样的 。它们都会收集过去的经验，然后训练 RSSM（循环状态空间模型）。</p>
</blockquote>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202603/3071480-20260315203530847-1265928929.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="不同点">不同点</h2>
<blockquote>
<p>有了“预测未来”的能力后，它们采取了不同的战术</p>
</blockquote>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202603/3071480-20260315203620304-136462770.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
